first_impression.summary_in_own_words: It's a planner's page for getting married in Portugal: palaces in Sintra, cliffs in the Algarve, and someone called a Wedded Advisor who plans it with you. The top reads more like a fact sheet (legal process, heat waves) than anything about what it costs or who I'd be talking to.

attention_map.quote: Get Married in Portugal, from a Sintra Palace to an Algarve Cliff
attention_map.why: Pretty headline, but then four flat lines about the legal process and heat waves. No price, no guest numbers. I kept going only because Portugal was new to us and the line about a Wedded Advisor 'who plans with you from the first enquiry' sounded like what we need.

attention_map.section: Hero quick form (season, guests, Check your date)
attention_map.quote: We confirm dates and venues with you.
attention_map.why: Short and doesn't ask for my email straight away, which I liked. But it didn't tell me anything back.

attention_map.section: Fall for Portugal Before You Choose a Venue
attention_map.quote: The legacy of Ferdinand II, the King-Artist
attention_map.why: History lesson. Nice at 10pm for about two cards, then it's just a long scroll of grey boxes and UNESCO dates. Monserrate 'roof works run until the first quarter of 2027' made me wonder if it's even available.
Finally something practical: which airport for which region. 'Not sure which region? Your Wedded Advisor helps you choose' is reassuring for someone with no idea where to start.

attention_map.quote: state events can cancel bookings at Queluz or the National Palace of Sintra
attention_map.why: Honest, but scary. Imagine flying 60 people over and the booking gets cancelled. At least it says 'We check the terms with you before you book'.

attention_map.section: See Why Couples Marry in Portugal
attention_map.quote: Visa-Free for US, UK and AU Passports
attention_map.why: Good that Australians are mentioned, but this repeats the region cards I just scrolled past.

attention_map.section: Pick the Setting for Your Ceremony
attention_map.quote: Some have rooms, so guests can stay where you marry
attention_map.why: Rooms on site is the one bit I cared about. Everything else repeats again: clifftops, vineyards, palaces, for the third time.

attention_map.section: What Your Wedded Advisor Checks in Every Venue Contract
attention_map.quote: exclusive use can mean paying for rooms your guests do not fill
attention_map.why: This is the first thing that speaks to my worry about the price blowing out. It tells me there are traps and someone will spot them. Still no figures though.

attention_map.section: Plan Your Portugal Wedding, Step by Step (getting there, entry rules)
attention_map.quote: Many Lisbon-area venues are 15 to 30 minutes from the city centre, as a guide
attention_map.why: Useful for our guests. The Australian passport bit with Smartraveller felt written for us.

attention_map.quote: An overseas marriage cannot be registered in Australia, but in most cases it is legally recognised
attention_map.why: Long, and that line made me slightly nervous. I'd send this part to my partner for the weekend rather than read it on the couch.

attention_map.section: What a Wedding in Portugal Costs
attention_map.quote: What a wedding in Portugal costs depends on five things: your guest count, the region, the season, how many nights you take the venue and whether you book it for exclusive use. We talk you through the options for your plans.
attention_map.why: This is the section I was scrolling for and it gives me nothing. Not even a rough 'from' number. It feels like they're hiding the price so I have to call.

attention_map.section: See What a Portugal Wedding Weekend Includes
attention_map.quote: There is no set Portugal package: every weekend is built to your plan.
attention_map.why: I like that it's not a cookie-cutter package and the list (welcome dinner, Sunday brunch, on-the-day coordinator) helps me picture it. But with no price next to it I can't tell if it's 40k or 140k.

attention_map.section: Bring Your Guests, or Keep It Exclusive to You
attention_map.quote: we check the options nearby for everyone else
attention_map.why: Answers 'where do our guests stay' only vaguely. The 'Start for free' Wonderland Studio button confused me, is that a different product?

attention_map.section: Plan Your Portugal Wedding with One Wedded Advisor
attention_map.quote: Your advisor talks you through your options: regions, venues, the legal route for your passport and what drives cost.
attention_map.why: The three steps are clear and it's one contact instead of chasing venues across time zones, which is exactly what I want. But there's no name or face, just 'a Wedded Advisor'. And 'Wedded Privileges' tells me nothing.

attention_map.quote: Budget, dates you have in mind, anything else
attention_map.why: Eleven fields on a phone. Not terrible since most are dropdowns, but I'm giving them my details and budget before they've given me any price.

attention_map.quote: How Much Is an Average Wedding in Portugal?
attention_map.why: Got my hopes up with that question and the answer ends with 'Wedded Concierge talks you through the options for your plans.' Second time the page dodges cost.

attention_map.quote: Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodriguez's wedding
attention_map.why: Feels like a gossip site tacked on the bottom. Doesn't help us.

questions_answered.question: What does this cost all in, and what is included in the from price?
questions_answered.evidence: No from price anywhere. The costs section only lists what cost 'depends on' and the FAQ 'How Much Is an Average Wedding in Portugal?' ends with 'talks you through the options'. The weekend list shows possible inclusions but with no price attached.

questions_answered.question: Can it fit our guest count?
questions_answered.evidence: There are 'How many guests?' dropdowns, and the Algarve FAQ says 'Ask us which suit your guest count', but no venue or space capacities are shown anywhere.

questions_answered.question: Who would actually plan this with us, and what do they do?
questions_answered.evidence: 'Wedded Concierge pairs you with a Wedded Advisor who plans with you from the first enquiry to the last dance' plus the three How It Works steps and the four contract checks explain what they do. No named person or photo of a real planner.

questions_answered.question: How do our guests get there and where do they stay?
questions_answered.evidence: Airports per region and 'Many Lisbon-area venues are 15 to 30 minutes from the city centre' answer getting there. Staying is only 'Some quintas have rooms for your closest guests; we check the options nearby for everyone else'.

questions_answered.question: Is our budget realistic for this place?
questions_answered.evidence: No figures, ranges or examples at all, so I can't tell if 50k for 60 people is laughable or fine.

objections_triggered.objection: I don't know if my budget is possible for this many people
objections_triggered.triggered_by: 'What a wedding in Portugal costs depends on five things' with no numbers, and no venue capacities

objections_triggered.objection: Prices look like they start low and will blow out
objections_triggered.triggered_by: No price signal at all; 'exclusive use can mean paying for rooms your guests do not fill' and 'a buy-out is often charged separately from the venue fee' tell me extras exist without telling me how big they are

objections_triggered.objection: Planning from overseas, time zones and suppliers I can't meet
objections_triggered.triggered_by: Mostly eased by 'one contact at Wedded Concierge, instead of one conversation per venue', but no name and nothing about how they work with Australians or time zones

objections_triggered.objection: Every planner's page looks the same
objections_triggered.triggered_by: Long runs of palace, clifftop and vineyard cards repeated three times; no real weddings or couples

trust_signals_noticed: Airports named for each region and a 15 to 30 minute transfer guide
Australian passport and Smartraveller rules spelled out
'Legal and travel details checked October 2026, with official sources named'
Contract checklist (rooms, buy-out vs venue fee, per day or per guest) shows they know where costs hide
Clear three-step How It Works with one advisor
Honest about Monserrate roof works and Sintra cancellation risk
turn_offs_noticed: No price signal at all, twice dodged (costs section and FAQ 4)
Very long page on a phone: roughly 38 screens, with palaces, clifftops and vineyards shown three times over
History and heritage trivia ('Port wine quality has been regulated since 1756') where I wanted practical info
Enquiry form asks for budget before I've seen any price

images.placeholders_seen: All images were grey placeholders, so I'm going on the labels.
stopped_me: quinta-stone-staircase-couple-portugal.jpg (a quinta staircase before dinner, guests staying where you marry) and the long dinner at a quinta, because they show what the weekend actually feels like
wedded-advisor-planning-with-couple.jpg, because I want to see who I'd be dealing with, if it's a real advisor
felt_generic: azulejo-tile-wall-detail-portugal.jpg and the fado guitar: travel-brochure filler
Repeated Pena, Algarve clifftop and Douro terrace shots: I saw the same three places about four times
Proposal, anniversary and birthday images: not relevant to us
images.missing: No real wedding at a real venue anywhere, and no photo of a named planner

emotional_response.overall: Interested in Portugal as an option, a bit overwhelmed by the length, and frustrated about price.
emotional_response.feels_intimate_and_us: The weekend list and quinta dinner image get close; the heritage cards feel like a tourism site
emotional_response.feels_different_from_standard_package: yes, 'There is no set Portugal package' landed

payload.decision_reason: Portugal now looks like a real option and I like the idea of one advisor who checks contracts and handles the legal side for our passports. But there is no from price, nothing on what anything costs, no guest capacities and no named planner, so I can't tell if our budget and 60 to 80 guests are realistic. I'd screenshot the airports and the weekend list, send it to my partner and maybe compare with the Italy page before filling in an 11-field form.
payload.verbatim_reaction: Okay, Portugal's actually gorgeous and cheaper-sounding than Como, but how much is it? I scrolled forever, there's a whole section called 'What a Wedding in Portugal Costs' and it just says it depends. The advisor thing sounds good, one person instead of emailing ten venues at midnight, but who is it? Saving this and sending it to babe. Not filling in the form until I know if we're in the ballpark.
